claims.claim: Scrap compact audio system that is currently not functioning.
claims.evidence: The witness report describes the unit as covered in a thick layer of dust with no evidence of it powering on.
The witness did not see the unit powered on or tested; this also contradicts the seller's own 'scrap' description.
Photo 0 shows no accessories or power cords.
Origin cannot be determined from visual inspection of the exterior.
Requires a functional audio test which was not performed.

risks.risk: Internal components (transformers, boards) may have been harvested.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear panel showing all screws intact and ports present.
risks.if_unproven: As incomplete scrap for weight only.

risks.risk: The 3-disc changer mechanism is jammed or broken.
risks.proof: Video of the CD tray opening, closing, and attempting to read.

risks.risk: Cassette deck belts have melted or motors are seized.
risks.proof: Video of the cassette spindles turning when play/fast-forward is pressed.

proof_requests: Photo of the rear connection ports and model label.
Video of the unit plugged in showing the display (if any) or any signs of life.
Photos of the included adapter and any speakers if they exist.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a non-functional Ministar hi-fi system. It can be priced at its worst-case value as scrap/parts since the seller admits it does not function.
